configuration.title: DeepSeek Harness
configuration.dshPath.description: Explicit path to the dsh executable used by the global managed runtime. Empty: discover via PATH, npm global prefix, then npx --no-install.
configuration.minDshVersion.description: Reserved compatibility floor. Versions are currently recorded but not rejected.
configuration.minDshVersion.deprecationM: Temporarily inactive until DSH exposes a trustworthy compatibility version.
configuration.externalUrl.description: External DSH base URL. When set, the extension only connects/disconnects and never manages that process.
configuration.discoveryPort.description: Loopback port probed first for an existing DSH instance.
configuration.managedPort.description: Fixed loopback port used by the cross-window managed DSH runtime. A non-DSH listener is reported as a conflict.
configuration.autoStart.description: Resolve and connect to the global DSH runtime when a workspace window opens.
configuration.locale.description: Display language for the extension UI. Auto-detects VS Code's display language when empty. Supported: en, zh-cn, zh-tw, ja, de, fr, es.
